phases.message: I'm Marcus, Okafor Trucking. My lease with Vessmoor ended in August and I still don't have my escrow. Start in Sheafbox: read the lease and its schedules and everything else in the folder.

This is Vessmoor's settlements portal. Read my escrow ledger and their final escrow statement, and open every deduction. Dispute every deduction the lease doesn't allow them, and claim any interest they still owe me, at the right amount. Leave alone what the lease lets them take.
This is my bank. Check what's come in from Vessmoor and from my old carrier.

This is my mail. Read what Vessmoor has sent, then send whoever still owes me an escrow a written demand for what they owe, at the right amount. Then tell me what you sent, what I should get back in all, and what you left alone and why.

documents.title: Vessmoor lease VT-OO-2207, sections 1 to 8
documents.text: Equipment lease and independent contractor agreement VT-OO-2207 between Vessmoor Transport Inc. (carrier, lessee), Joliet, Illinois, and Okafor Trucking LLC (Marcus Okafor, lessor), for the lessor's 2021 tractor, unit 207, signed Wednesday 1 October 2025. Term: from 1 October 2025 until either party ends it on 30 days' written notice; no fee or penalty for ending it. Compensation: 75% of the line haul revenue of each load, with a copy of the rated freight bill. Payment within 15 days of the delivery documents (49 CFR 376.12(f)). Section 8, chargebacks: the items Vessmoor may pay first and deduct from settlements are listed in Schedule A, each with how it is computed, and Vessmoor gives the lessor a copy of the documents behind each charge (376.12(h)). No other item is charged back. Section 9, the escrow, is in L-2.

documents.title: Vessmoor lease VT-OO-2207, section 9: the escrow fund
documents.text: 9.1 Amount: $2,500, paid by the lessor at signing. 9.2 The escrow may be applied only to: (a) fuel card purchases, fuel or otherwise, not recovered from settlements; (b) tolls and scale tickets not recovered from settlements; (c) Vessmoor equipment not returned at the end of the lease, at the replacement cost in Schedule B; (d) the unrecovered cost of the apportioned plate, as Schedule B computes it; (e) Schedule A chargebacks not recovered from the final settlement. 9.3 Every deduction or addition is shown on the settlement sheets, and the lessor may demand an accounting at any time. 9.4 Interest: paid each calendar quarter while Vessmoor holds the fund, including after the lease ends until the fund is returned, credited on the first settlement after the quarter ends, simple interest on the balance for the actual days over 365, at the investment rate of the last 13-week Treasury bill auction held before the first day of the quarter. Vessmoor deducts no advance from the balance. 9.5 Return: within 45 days after the lease ends, less only the items in 9.2, with a final accounting of every deduction.

documents.title: Schedules A and B to lease VT-OO-2207
documents.text: Schedule A, chargebacks: occupational accident insurance, $48 a week, at the insurer's invoice; trailer rental, none (the lessor pulls Vessmoor's trailers at no charge); ELD service, none. Schedule B, equipment and plate: the ELD unit (replacement cost $350 if not returned), the fuel card ($25 if not returned) and the trailer keys (none). The apportioned plate is bought by Vessmoor for the registration year; if the lease ends early, the lessor repays the plate's cost for the whole months left on the registration after the lease ends. The 2026 plate for unit 207 cost $558 and expires 31 December 2026.

documents.title: Termination notice, Okafor Trucking to Vessmoor, 22 July 2026
documents.text: Wednesday 22 July 2026. To Vessmoor Transport Inc., owner-operator services: Okafor Trucking LLC gives 30 days' written notice under section 1 of lease VT-OO-2207. The lease ends at the close of Friday 21 August 2026. Unit 207 will run loads to that date. Marcus Okafor. Vessmoor acknowledged receipt by email the same day.

documents.title: 49 CFR 376.12, the Truth-in-Leasing rule, as it stands on 9 October 2026
documents.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026. 376.12(k): if escrow is required, the lease specifies its amount, the specific items it can be applied to, an accounting of every transaction, the lessor's right to demand an accounting at any time, interest paid at least quarterly while the carrier controls the fund at a rate set on the date the interest period begins and at least equal to the average yield or equivalent coupon issue yield on 13-week Treasury bills in the weekly auction, and the conditions for its return: at return the carrier may deduct monies for obligations previously specified in the lease, gives a final accounting, and in no event returns the fund later than 45 days from the date of termination. 376.12(h): the lease specifies every chargeback item and how it is computed, and the lessor gets the documents to check each charge. A lessor may sue a carrier that breaks these rules (49 U.S.C. 14704(a)(2)).
